scope: REAL SimpleCube++ source training/development validation only
evidence_kind: MEASURED reused development-validation/model-selection evidence; one seed; not an independent benchmark

matched_protocol.warmup: point-only epochs1-20; field fraction (epoch-20)/20 clamped0..1 thereafter
matched_protocol.augmentation: Common exposure exp(U[-.5,.5]), independent horizontal flip p.5; no channel/color perturbation
matched_protocol.optimizer: AdamW .001 wd.0001 cosinefloor.00002 clip5; FP32 noAMP/noTF32
matched_protocol.checkpoint_selection: Lowest step2 mean reproduction on development val at valid>=.99; also preserve independent best direct-point epoch
matched_protocol.test_time_compute: One cached encoder; steps1/2/4=25/51/103 router queries; GT never enters policy

source_input_validity.scope: Only source train1126 and val119 numerically decoded; no GT key read

warmup_reproducibility.interpretation: Same-seed single runs diverged before mode-specific field training; mode gaps are not stable causal estimates. Use a paired starting checkpoint and multiple seeds next.
